QUOTE: The library itself is the only consumer of the setter. `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(...)` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` and `buffer_alloc_free`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as the sole in-tree caller of the setter, installing its own calloc/free pointers.
